title: Shraddh tithi kaise pata karein?
body: Shraddh tareekh se nahi, tithi se hota hai — us tithi par jis din purvaj ka dehant hua tha.
bullets: Dehant wale din ki tithi dekhiye
Pitru Paksha mein wahi tithi, wahi shraddh
Tithi yaad nahi? 10 Oct, Sarva Pitru Amavasya

title: गुरु प्रदोष व्रत
body: Bhadrapada Shukla Trayodashi. Suryast ke aas-paas ka pradosh kaal Shiv puja ke liye maana jaata hai.
bullets: Shivling par jal aur bel patra
Pradosh kaal mein deep aur dhoop
ॐ नमः शिवाय ka jaap

title: अनंत चतुर्दशी
body: Bhadrapada Shukla Chaturdashi. Bhagwan Vishnu ke Anant roop ki puja, aur Ganeshotsav ke baad Bappa ki vidaai.
bullets: Anant sutra — 14 gaanth wala dhaaga
Visarjan ghar par, baalti ya tub mein bhi
Kal se Pitru Paksha shuru

title: पितृ पक्ष
body: Aaj Bhadrapada Purnima. Purvajon ko shraddha aur kritagyata ke saath yaad karne ke din shuru.
bullets: Aaj 26 Sept: Purnima shraddh
Kal 27 Sept: Pratipada shraddh
10 Oct: Sarva Pitru Amavasya

title: Tarpan ki saral vidhi
body: Ghar par, kam samay mein. Parivaar ki parampara aur purohit ki salah sabse upar.
bullets: Jal, kaale til aur kush
Dakshin disha ki or mukh karke
Naam lekar teen baar anjali se jal

title: Shraddh bhojan: kuch aam baatein
body: Har ghar ki apni parampara hoti hai. Ye wo baatein hain jo zyaadatar parivaaron mein milti hain.
bullets: Saada, satvik bhojan
Pehla hissa gaay, kauve aur kutte ke liye
Pyaaz-lehsun se parhez

title: Panchang, apni bhasha mein
body: Ghar mein har kisi ki bhasha alag? Divyam 14 Indian languages mein hai — sabke liye, free.
bullets: Roz ki tithi aur shraddh tithi
Rashifal aur festival calendar
AI Kundli, bina kisi charge ke
